name: The Hero Twins (Naayééʼ Neizghání / Monster Slayer and Tóbájíshchíní / Born-for-Water)

domain_history.domain: sons of Changing Woman, fathered by the Sun (Jóhonaaʼéí); undertake a journey to their father's house, undergo trials to prove legitimacy, are given weapons; rid the world of the naayééʼ (monsters) threatening early humanity, including the giant Yéitso at what is now Shiprock (Tsé Bitʼaʼí); Monster Slayer is the more active combatant, Born-for-Water plays a supportive/protective role

notes: Sourced to Washington Matthews, Navaho Legends (1897), cross-checked against native-languages.org and NHMU Baskets collection materials for name variants.
